messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kiera,

Pangea's executive-search work across energy, infrastructure and natural resources makes this a focused introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government/regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate/external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder engagement.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates, particularly across the GCC and other major infrastructure and energy markets.

My executive CV is attached for consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
